Name: Expressive
Description: Material Expressive: насичені тональні поверхні, форми, що змінюються під курсором, і пружні анімації.
StyleResources:
<ResourceDictionary xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" xmlns:fx="clr-namespace:CategoryBar.Theming;assembly=CategoryBar">
  <!--
    Material Expressive. Shapes are rectangles whose corner radius is animated: a pill relaxes into a rounded
    square under the pointer and the open tab is a filled shape that stretches into place. Everything arrives
    with a spring; the "smooth" motion style keeps the same choreography without the overshoot.
  -->

  <!-- Tabs: a tonal pill on hover, a filled accent shape for the open category. -->
  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.TabTemplate" TargetType="ContentControl">
    <Grid Background="Transparent">
      <Rectangle x:Name="hover" RadiusX="20" RadiusY="20" Fill="{DynamicResource Accent.Soft}" Opacity="0" IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
      <Rectangle x:Name="shape" RadiusX="20" RadiusY="20" Fill="{DynamicResource Accent.Fill}" Opacity="0" IsHitTestVisible="False" fx:ThemeTransform.ScaleX="1"/>
      <ContentPresenter Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
      <Rectangle x:Name="running" Width="16" Height="3" RadiusX="1.5" RadiusY="1.5" Margin="0,0,0,3" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Fill="{TemplateBinding Foreground}" Opacity="0" IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
    </Grid>
    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
      <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
        <Setter TargetName="hover" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/><Setter TargetName="hover" Property="RadiusX" Value="12"/><Setter TargetName="hover" Property="RadiusY" Value="12"/>
        <Trigger.EnterActions><BeginStoryboard><Storyboard FillBehavior="Stop">
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="hover" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.1"/>
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="hover" Storyboard.TargetProperty="RadiusX" From="20" To="12" Duration="0:0:0.22"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.6"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="hover" Storyboard.TargetProperty="RadiusY" From="20" To="12" Duration="0:0:0.22"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.6"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
        </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.EnterActions>
        <Trigger.ExitActions><BeginStoryboard><Storyboard FillBehavior="Stop">
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="hover" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="1" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.18"/>
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="hover" Storyboard.TargetProperty="RadiusX" From="12" To="20" Duration="0:0:0.18"/>
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="hover" Storyboard.TargetProperty="RadiusY" From="12" To="20" Duration="0:0:0.18"/>
        </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.ExitActions>
      </Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="fx:ThemeVisual.IsRunning" Value="True"><Setter TargetName="running" Property="Opacity" Value="0.85"/></Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="fx:ThemeVisual.IsSelected" Value="True">
        <Setter TargetName="shape" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/><Setter TargetName="shape" Property="RadiusX" Value="14"/><Setter TargetName="shape" Property="RadiusY" Value="14"/>
        <Setter TargetName="hover" Property="Visibility" Value="Hidden"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource tab:selected.Foreground}"/>
        <Trigger.EnterActions><BeginStoryboard><Storyboard FillBehavior="Stop">
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="shape" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.08"/>
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="shape" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.ScaleX)" From="0.55" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.38"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.9"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="shape" Storyboard.TargetProperty="RadiusX" From="20" To="14" Duration="0:0:0.3"/>
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="shape" Storyboard.TargetProperty="RadiusY" From="20" To="14" Duration="0:0:0.3"/>
        </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.EnterActions>
        <Trigger.ExitActions><BeginStoryboard><Storyboard FillBehavior="Stop">
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="shape" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="1" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.16"/>
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="shape" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.ScaleX)" From="1" To="0.8" Duration="0:0:0.16"/>
        </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.ExitActions>
      </Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="fx:ThemeVisual.IsDropTarget" Value="True">
        <Setter TargetName="shape" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/><Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource tab:selected.Foreground}"/>
      </Trigger>
    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
  </ControlTemplate>

  <!-- Menu rows: the pill under the pointer tightens its corners. -->
  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.MenuItemTemplate" TargetType="ContentControl">
    <Grid Background="Transparent">
      <Rectangle x:Name="shape" RadiusX="26" RadiusY="26" Fill="{DynamicResource Accent.Soft}" Opacity="0" IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
      <Rectangle x:Name="drop" RadiusX="16" RadiusY="16" Stroke="{DynamicResource Accent}" StrokeThickness="2" Opacity="0" IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
      <ContentPresenter Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}" VerticalAlignment="{TemplateBinding VerticalContentAlignment}"/>
    </Grid>
    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
      <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
        <Setter TargetName="shape" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/><Setter TargetName="shape" Property="RadiusX" Value="16"/><Setter TargetName="shape" Property="RadiusY" Value="16"/>
        <Trigger.EnterActions><BeginStoryboard><Storyboard FillBehavior="Stop">
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="shape" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.08"/>
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="shape" Storyboard.TargetProperty="RadiusX" From="26" To="16" Duration="0:0:0.24"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.7"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="shape" Storyboard.TargetProperty="RadiusY" From="26" To="16" Duration="0:0:0.24"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.7"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
        </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.EnterActions>
        <Trigger.ExitActions><BeginStoryboard><Storyboard FillBehavior="Stop">
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="shape" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="1" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.16"/>
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="shape" Storyboard.TargetProperty="RadiusX" From="16" To="26" Duration="0:0:0.16"/>
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="shape" Storyboard.TargetProperty="RadiusY" From="16" To="26" Duration="0:0:0.16"/>
        </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.ExitActions>
      </Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="fx:ThemeVisual.IsSelected" Value="True"><Setter TargetName="shape" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/><Setter TargetName="shape" Property="RadiusX" Value="16"/><Setter TargetName="shape" Property="RadiusY" Value="16"/></Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="fx:ThemeVisual.IsDropTarget" Value="True"><Setter TargetName="shape" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/><Setter TargetName="drop" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/></Trigger>
    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
  </ControlTemplate>
  <!-- The category name is a headline, not a caption. -->
  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.MenuHeaderTemplate" TargetType="fx:ThemeSurface">
    <Grid Margin="12,6,4,10" MinHeight="30"><Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition/><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
      <TextBlock Text="{TemplateBinding Header}" FontSize="19" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Text}" VerticalAlignment="Center" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
      <ContentPresenter Grid.Column="1" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
    </Grid>
  </ControlTemplate>

  <!-- Buttons relax from a pill to a rounded square on hover and give way when pressed. -->
  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.ButtonTemplate" TargetType="Button">
    <Grid x:Name="root" Background="Transparent" fx:ThemeTransform.Scale="1">
      <Rectangle x:Name="shape" RadiusX="20" RadiusY="20" Fill="{TemplateBinding Background}"/>
      <Rectangle x:Name="state" RadiusX="20" RadiusY="20" Fill="{DynamicResource Hover}" Opacity="0"/>
      <Rectangle x:Name="focus" RadiusX="20" RadiusY="20" Stroke="{DynamicResource Text}" StrokeThickness="2" Opacity="0"/>
      <ContentPresenter Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}" HorizontalAlignment="{TemplateBinding HorizontalContentAlignment}" VerticalAlignment="{TemplateBinding VerticalContentAlignment}"/>
    </Grid>
    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
      <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
        <Setter TargetName="state" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/>
        <Setter TargetName="shape" Property="RadiusX" Value="12"/><Setter TargetName="shape" Property="RadiusY" Value="12"/>
        <Setter TargetName="state" Property="RadiusX" Value="12"/><Setter TargetName="state" Property="RadiusY" Value="12"/>
        <Trigger.EnterActions><BeginStoryboard><Storyboard FillBehavior="Stop">
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="shape" Storyboard.TargetProperty="RadiusX" From="20" To="12" Duration="0:0:0.22"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.6"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="shape" Storyboard.TargetProperty="RadiusY" From="20" To="12" Duration="0:0:0.22"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.6"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="state" Storyboard.TargetProperty="RadiusX" From="20" To="12" Duration="0:0:0.22"/>
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="state" Storyboard.TargetProperty="RadiusY" From="20" To="12" Duration="0:0:0.22"/>
        </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.EnterActions>
        <Trigger.ExitActions><BeginStoryboard><Storyboard FillBehavior="Stop">
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="shape" Storyboard.TargetProperty="RadiusX" From="12" To="20" Duration="0:0:0.2"/>
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="shape" Storyboard.TargetProperty="RadiusY" From="12" To="20" Duration="0:0:0.2"/>
        </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.ExitActions>
      </Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="IsPressed" Value="True">
        <Setter TargetName="state" Property="Fill" Value="{DynamicResource Pressed}"/>
        <Setter TargetName="root" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.Scale" Value="0.95"/>
      </Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="IsKeyboardFocused" Value="True"><Setter TargetName="focus" Property="Opacity" Value="0.7"/></Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False"><Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.4"/></Trigger>
    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
  </ControlTemplate>

  <!-- The Material switch: a wide track and a handle that grows when it turns on. -->
  <Style x:Key="Toggle" TargetType="CheckBox">
    <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
    <Setter Property="Template">
      <Setter.Value>
        <ControlTemplate TargetType="CheckBox">
          <Grid Width="52" Height="32" Background="Transparent">
            <Border x:Name="track" CornerRadius="16" Background="{DynamicResource Control.Bg}" BorderThickness="2" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource Text.Faint}"/>
            <Ellipse x:Name="knob" Width="16" Height="16" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Margin="8,0,0,0" Fill="{DynamicResource Text.Faint}" fx:ThemeTransform.X="0" fx:ThemeTransform.Scale="1"/>
          </Grid>
          <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True"><Setter TargetName="knob" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.Scale" Value="1.15"/></Trigger>
            <Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="True">
              <Setter TargetName="track" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource Accent.Fill}"/><Setter TargetName="track" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource Accent.Fill}"/>
              <Setter TargetName="knob" Property="Fill" Value="{DynamicResource Accent.FillText}"/>
              <Setter TargetName="knob" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.X" Value="20"/><Setter TargetName="knob" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.Scale" Value="1.5"/>
              <Trigger.EnterActions><BeginStoryboard><Storyboard FillBehavior="Stop">
                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="knob" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.X)" From="0" To="20" Duration="0:0:0.28"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.8"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="knob" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Scale)" From="1" To="1.5" Duration="0:0:0.28"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.8"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
              </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.EnterActions>
              <Trigger.ExitActions><BeginStoryboard><Storyboard FillBehavior="Stop">
                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="knob" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.X)" From="20" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.28"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.8"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="knob" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Scale)" From="1.5" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.28"/>
              </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.ExitActions>
            </Trigger>
            <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False"><Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.4"/></Trigger>
          </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
        </ControlTemplate>
      </Setter.Value>
    </Setter>
  </Style>
  <Style x:Key="Segment" TargetType="RadioButton">
    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource Text.Muted}"/><Setter Property="FontSize" Value="13"/>
    <Setter Property="Template">
      <Setter.Value>
        <ControlTemplate TargetType="RadioButton">
          <Grid MinHeight="34" Background="Transparent">
            <Rectangle x:Name="shape" RadiusX="17" RadiusY="17" Fill="{DynamicResource Accent.Soft}" Opacity="0"/>
            <ContentPresenter Margin="16,5" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
          </Grid>
          <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True"><Setter TargetName="shape" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/></Trigger>
            <Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="True">
              <Setter TargetName="shape" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/><Setter TargetName="shape" Property="Fill" Value="{DynamicResource Accent.Fill}"/>
              <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource Accent.FillText}"/><Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="SemiBold"/>
            </Trigger>
          </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
        </ControlTemplate>
      </Setter.Value>
    </Setter>
  </Style>

  <!-- Navigation as a floating toolbar above the page, or as a rail on the left: the user's choice. -->
  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.WorkspaceTemplate" TargetType="fx:ThemeSurface">
    <Grid Background="Transparent"><Grid.RowDefinitions><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><RowDefinition/></Grid.RowDefinitions>
      <ContentControl Style="{DynamicResource Theme.Sidebar}" Margin="14,0,14,12" Padding="4" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Content="{TemplateBinding Header}"/>
      <ContentControl Grid.Row="1" Style="{DynamicResource Theme.Page}" Content="{TemplateBinding Content}"/>
    </Grid>
  </ControlTemplate>
  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Expressive.RailWorkspace" TargetType="fx:ThemeSurface">
    <Grid Background="Transparent"><Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/><ColumnDefinition/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
      <ContentControl Style="{DynamicResource Theme.Sidebar}" Width="{DynamicResource sidebar.Width}" Margin="{DynamicResource sidebar.Margin}" Content="{TemplateBinding Header}"/>
      <ContentControl Grid.Column="1" Style="{DynamicResource Theme.Page}" Content="{TemplateBinding Content}"/>
    </Grid>
  </ControlTemplate>
  <Style x:Key="Theme.Workspace" TargetType="fx:ThemeSurface">
    <Setter Property="Template" Value="{DynamicResource Theme.WorkspaceTemplate}"/><Setter Property="Tag" Value="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.navigation}"/>
    <Style.Triggers><Trigger Property="Tag" Value="left"><Setter Property="Template" Value="{DynamicResource Expressive.RailWorkspace}"/></Trigger></Style.Triggers>
  </Style>
  <Style x:Key="Theme.NavigationPanel" TargetType="StackPanel">
    <Setter Property="Orientation" Value="Horizontal"/><Setter Property="Tag" Value="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.navigation}"/><Setter Property="Margin" Value="2,0"/>
    <Style.Triggers><Trigger Property="Tag" Value="left"><Setter Property="Orientation" Value="Vertical"/><Setter Property="Margin" Value="10,6"/></Trigger></Style.Triggers>
  </Style>

  <!-- Motion, bouncy by default. -->
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Bar.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.14"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Y)" From="30" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.42"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.9"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Tab.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.1"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Scale)" From="0.4" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.44"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><ElasticEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Oscillations="1" Springiness="4"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Menu.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.1"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.ScaleY)" From="0.6" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.36"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.8"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.ScaleX)" From="0.88" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.36"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.8"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Menu.Exit" FillBehavior="HoldEnd">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.12"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.ScaleY)" To="0.85" Duration="0:0:0.12"/>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Menu.Switch" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0.2" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.14"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.X)" From="14" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.3"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.7"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.MenuItem.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.12"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.X)" From="-18" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.34"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.9"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Card.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.14"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Y)" From="22" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.4"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.7"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Page.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop"><DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.12"/></Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Window.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.14"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Scale)" From="0.93" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.36"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.7"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Toast.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.12"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Y)" From="26" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.4"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.9"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Toast.Exit" FillBehavior="HoldEnd">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.14"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Y)" To="16" Duration="0:0:0.14"/>
  </Storyboard>

  <!-- The same choreography without overshoot. -->
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Bar.Enter.smooth" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.18"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Y)" From="16" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.26"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Tab.Enter.smooth" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.18"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Y)" From="10" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.24"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Menu.Enter.smooth" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.16"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Scale)" From="0.94" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.22"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Menu.Switch.smooth" FillBehavior="Stop"><DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0.3" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.16"/></Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.MenuItem.Enter.smooth" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.16"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.X)" From="-8" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.2"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Card.Enter.smooth" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.18"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Y)" From="10" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.22"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Window.Enter.smooth" FillBehavior="Stop"><DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.18"/></Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Toast.Enter.smooth" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.18"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Y)" From="12" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.22"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
</ResourceDictionary>

Parameters.Label: Тонування поверхонь акцентом
Parameters.Description: Скільки акцентного кольору домішується до панелі, меню й карток.

Parameters.Label: Затримка між елементами
Parameters.Description: Вкладки, рядки меню й картки з’являються одна за одною.
